title: Animal Feeding Stuff - Determination of Nitrogen Content and Calculation of Crude Protein Content - Kjeldahl Method
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14825) covers Animal Feeding Stuff - Determination of Nitrogen Content and Calculation of Crude Protein Content - Kjeldahl Method. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 5983 : 1997 'Animal feeding stuffs — Determination of nitrogen content and calculation of crude protein content — Kjeldahl method* issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the on the recommendation of the Livestock Feeds Sectional Committee and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council. Method of test for determination of nitrogen content and calculation of crude protein content — Kjeldahl method, was covered in 5 of IS 7874 (Part 1); after publication of this Indian Standard the above referred clause of IS 7874 (Part 1) will he deleted through amendment. In this adopted standard, certain terminology and conventions are not identical to those used in Indian Standards. clause_3_terminology: Determination of Nitrogen Content and Calculation of Crude Protein Content

chemical_properties: nitrogen from acetanilide or tryptophan should be at least 99,5 %
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
